headline: Google brings ads to AI search in India
deck: A placement change that paid-search teams should track.
slides: Google is expanding sponsored placements in AI Mode to 10 markets, including India, Canada and Singapore.
Eligible campaigns can appear in AI Mode. Advertisers currently lack standalone AI Mode reporting in Google Ads.
Save this for your next review
Log the rollout date. Track spend, conversion quality and acquisition cost. Label your findings as overall Search performance.

headline: One input. Up to 1,000 AI checks.
deck: Google says its Gemini Decisions API can evaluate up to 1,000 closed-set questions against the same input. Here is what that could look like for a support team.
slides: Google says its Gemini Decisions API can evaluate up to 1,000 closed-set questions against the same text, image, audio, video or PDF input.
Teams can test it on repeated decisions, such as routing support tickets or flagging documents for human review.
Before automating ticket routing, benchmark against human-labeled tickets, track wrong routes, and test when to hand a case back to a reviewer.

headline: Google opens preorders for Gemini eyewear
deck: An AI launch with a privacy question for enterprise buyers.
slides: Google opened preorders for intelligent eyewear developed with Warby Parker, Gentle Monster and Samsung.
Wearable AI can use what a person sees to assist them. Teams evaluating it need to consider people and information in the camera’s field of view.
Ask when the camera activates, what leaves the device, and how long information is retained. Decide where staff can wear the devices.
